parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The type of the sensitive data detection rule content. Valid values:
- **2**: regular expression.
- **3**: algorithm.
- **5**: keyword.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The content of the sensitive data detection rule. The content can be a regular expression, algorithm, or keyword that is used to match sensitive data fields or text.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description:
The unique ID of the sensitive data detection rule.

You can call the [DescribeRules](~~DescribeRules~~) operation to obtain the rule ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:

- **zh_cn**: Simplified Chinese.
- **en_us**: English (US).

parameters.name: MatchType
parameters.description:
The match type. Valid values:
- **1**: rule match.
- **2**: dictionary match.

parameters.name: ModelRuleIds
parameters.description: The collection of model IDs associated with the sensitive data audit.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the sensitive data detection rule.

You can call the [DescribeRules](~~DescribeRules~~) operation to obtain the rule name.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The resource type of the product that contains the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **MaxCompute**
- **OSS**
- **ADS**
- **OTS**
- **RDS**
- **SELF_DB**

parameters.name: ProductId
parameters.description:
The product ID of the product that contains the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **1**: MaxCompute.
- **2**: OSS.
- **3**: ADS.
- **4**: OTS.
- **5**: RDS.
- **6**: SELF_DB.

parameters.name: RiskLevelId
parameters.description:
The risk level ID of the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **1**: N/A. No sensitive data is detected.
- **2**: S1. Level-1 sensitive data.
- **3**: S2. Level-2 sensitive data.
- **4**: S3. Level-3 sensitive data.
- **5**: S4. Level-4 sensitive data.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **1**: data detection rule.
- **2**: audit policy.
- **3**: anomalous activity rule.

parameters.name: SupportForm
parameters.description:
The data asset type supported by the rule. Valid values:
- **0**: all assets.
- **1**: structured assets.
- **2**: unstructured assets.

parameters.name: TemplateRuleIds
parameters.description: The collection of template IDs associated with the sensitive data audit.

parameters.name: WarnLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level of the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **1**: low.
- **2**: medium.
- **3**: high.
